_doc: Fold-pinning fixtures for the work-tier join key. The index Worker (apps/index-worker) computes title_fold and creator_fold on write, and those folds MUST equal library_catalog's normaliseTitle / normaliseTitle(primaryAuthor(...)) — otherwise 'same book' means two different things in the estate, because work_fold replicates what work_key means. This file is the UNIVERSES mechanism applied again: one fixture file, N implementations, each repo's CI asserts its own implementation reproduces every case, so drift breaks a build loudly instead of a join silently.
_measured: Every `fold` value below was produced by executing library_catalog packages/core/src/titles.ts on 2026-08-13 — measured, not hand-computed. If a case here looks wrong, the fix is a MIGRATION in the library (stored work_key rows depend on this fold), never an edit to this file to match a new implementation.
_contract: titles: fold === normaliseTitle(raw). authors: primary === primaryAuthor(raw) and fold === normaliseTitle(primaryAuthor(raw)). An empty-string fold is a REAL expected value: wholly non-Latin input folds to ''. What each consumer does about '' is its own documented policy — the library keeps the degenerate key (a known production wart, two Korean works), the index Worker stores NULL and excludes the row from key joins (the refusal wrapper, index-only, NOT part of this contract).
_runners: library_catalog  — npm test (packages/core/test/fold-fixtures.test.ts, file materialised by scripts/sync-universes.mjs)

titles.raw: A Court of Thorns and Roses
Café at the Edge of the World
titles.fold: cafe at the edge of the world
titles.why: diacritics folded; only the LEADING article is stripped, interior 'the' survives

titles.raw: The Frugal Wizard’s Handbook for Surviving Medieval England
titles.fold: frugal wizard s handbook for surviving medieval england
titles.why: curly apostrophe (U+2019) becomes a space, leaving a free-standing 's' — the real audiobook row spelling
a bare trailing number IS the title (Eric Vall) and survives the fold
⚠️ wholly non-Latin folds to EMPTY — the '|samg' production bug. The index stores NULL for this and refuses key joins; the library still carries the degenerate key (known wart)

titles.raw: Betrayal at House on the Hill
titles.fold: betrayal at house on the hill
titles.why: a board game title — same fold, one implementation estate-wide

authors.raw: Oleg Sapphire, Alexey Kovtunov, Jennifer E. Sunseri - Translator
authors.why: comma split; the '- Translator' suffix must never become an author
one of the two real author spellings behind the Korean-title collision risk
the other spelling — one author-merge away from colliding two empty-title keys; the reason the index refuses author-only joins
⚠️ wholly non-Latin author folds to EMPTY — creator_fold NULL at the index, so work_fold is NULL and the row can never key-join

⚠️ the library's authorless SENTINEL folds to plain 'unknown' — indistinguishable from a real 'Unknown' credit, which is exactly why workKeyFor bypasses the fold for it and why the index must refuse to fold the sentinel at all (creator_fold NULL), never store 'unknown'
